entry.author: City Rail Link
entry.summary:
The engineering challenges in constructing the City Rail Link were enormous.
While the giant tunnel boring machine built the underground tunnels, a range of other giant machines were needed.
They show how complex the job was and how it spread through various areas of Auckland as we helped transform Auckland’s rail network.
We explore this in the third of our five-part series on the building of Auckland’s City Rail Link.  Meet the likes of Sandrine, Jeffie and other machinery characters.
